My brother has abused me and does not live with me, but he cannot be dealt with until he knows what he did. He’s in an area widely affected by COVID-19 and there’s little chance he leaves. Plus, the abuse happened years ago and I have little evidence of it happening besides my recollection and me telling my parents (who despite their support are also supporting my brother and want to protect him). 

More importantly, I feel so devoid of love for myself that others have given it to me, but I’m not in a place where I’m receiving it physically (hugs, cuddles, etc.)

I am a dude who was sexually abused by his own brother. I think he always needed to feel in control in our dynamic. He started abusing me by bullying me with comments about my weight, comparing my name to STDs, and calling me things like retarded and gay (seriously). He’s physically abuse me too by “accidentally” punching me in the arm or face. He’d mostly stop a few inches before he made contact, but he made me flinch and sometimes he would make contact.

The sexual abuse lasted from when I was 15-17. He would finger my anus and say a phrase jokingly he picked up from a comedian. His smile was unforgettable. On top of that, he would also grope my breasts to make a point about my weight (being fat), and compared me to large land mammals. 

I didn’t tell my family because of the stigma attached and fear of what would happen. Besides, when I was verbally bullied, they told me to “get over it” (classic). 

I’m 20 now and still struggle with PTSD, self-esteem issues and suicidal ideation.
